name: Memento Mori, Hazel
source:
Memento Mori, Hazel is a story set in a dreamworld where beings from across different worlds have been trapped. Her dream is coming to an end and reality is finally catching up with her. 

[From [url=https://pc0hidq.itch.io/mementomori]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Memento Mori, Hazel》的故事发生在一个梦境世界，来自不同世界的生灵都被困在这里。她的梦即将结束，而现实终于追上了她。

[摘自[url=https://pc0hidq.itch.io/mementomori]itch.io[/url]]
